How It Works

Three simple steps to your project

No complicated process — message us, approve the work, receive the final files.

01

Tell us your idea

Message on WhatsApp with what you need — a video, a thumbnail, a website or a full content package. We discuss the details and price upfront.

02

We create, you review

The studio designs and builds your project, then shares a preview. You ask for changes until it looks exactly right.

03

Final delivery

You receive the finished files in full quality, ready to post, publish or launch — with support if you need changes later.

Questions

Before you message us

How do I start a project?

Just send a WhatsApp message on 0304 7809156 with what you need, or fill in the project brief below — it opens WhatsApp with your brief ready to send. Details and price are discussed upfront, before any work begins.

What should I send for a video or edit?

Your footage, photos, logo and any text you want included. Your original material is used exactly as you give it — never replaced or altered without your say.

Can I ask for changes after seeing the preview?

Yes. Every project comes with a preview first, and you can ask for changes until it looks exactly right before final delivery.

Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes — the studio is based in Lahore and works with clients in Pakistan and abroad, in both Urdu and English. Everything happens over WhatsApp and email.
